caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a male head shown in profile facing to the right. The bust is rendered in shades of brown, with darker and lighter tones used to highlight the contours and details of the hair, ear, forehead, nose, lips, and chin. The hair is wavy and appears textured, and the figure has a beard that follows the jawline and chin, with a mustache above the upper lip. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color. There are no other objects or details in the background, making the bust the central and sole focus of the composition. In the lower right corner, the name "Carl Bueg-genniss." is written, likely indicating the artist's signature.
title: Cast Iron Abraham Lincoln
